desc: Read N, K, array A, and compute total_xor.
Handle trivial cases: K == N (answer total_xor), K == 1 (answer max(A)), and N-K == 0.
Choose enumeration side: if K <= N-K enumerate chosen K elements; otherwise enumerate excluded N-K elements and use total_xor ^ excluded_xor.
Implement efficient r-combination enumeration with incremental XOR, avoiding materializing all combinations; include fast paths for r=0,1,2 and a recursive/iterative fallback for larger r.
For each complete combination, compute candidate XOR and update global maximum.
Test on sample inputs and edge cases (K=N, K=1, duplicate values, large N with small K/N-K).
